concept.name: Wardrobe / curvy silhouette / Double-L
concept.reading: Opposing wardrobe doors reveal Lulu's confident hourglass silhouette; mirrored L feet place Lulu in the foundation of the mark.
concept.brandMeaning: Lulu's wardrobe, opened for another urban woman.

roles.logo: Exact owner-supplied four-row centered logo for social identity, formal brand display, signage, packaging fronts, hang tags, and name-bearing square or vertical placements.
roles.wordmark: Unchanged exact lowercase justurban wears outlined wordmark for Shop and Studio navigation, editorial signatures, and horizontal spaces.
roles.icon: Owner-selected cocoa circular seal with copper curvy silhouette and mirrored-L forms for favicon, installed app, device tiles, and compact Studio.

verbalIdentity.headline: Clothes with a second first impression.
verbalIdentity.descriptor: One-off urban womenswear from Lulu’s wardrobe, ready to move through the city.

logo.policy: Preserve the corrected four-row lettering, spelling, spacing, colour, and transparency exactly.

icon.policy: Preserve every opaque source RGB pixel inside the cocoa seal. The exterior is transparent and its antialiased edge is decontaminated from the former white background.

flatProductionIcon.policy: Retained only for existing one-colour production-method exports. It is not the web icon or favicon.

format.logoSvgStrategy: Exact corrected PNG embedded losslessly in an SVG document.
format.iconSvgStrategy: Exact approved PNG embedded losslessly in SVG documents; platform PNGs are scaled derivatives.

vectorRebuild.rule: A vector replacement must preserve the approved silhouette, mirrored L feet, corrected typography, and spacing, pass direct visual comparison, and receive owner approval.

minimumSize.rule: Use generated finite favicon assets at 16–48 px; do not improvise a new icon drawing.

typography.logoPrimary: Bodoni Moda Variable 500 with accepted tight tracking
typography.logoSignature: Manrope Variable 600 uppercase with generous tracking

profile.assetRole: Name-bearing centered logo; safe for circular profile crops.

openGraph.assetRole: Exact owner-selected portrait signage image, without cropping, recompression, or overlays.
